h2. Description

*When a keyboard user's move leaves nothing matching the filters, keyboard focus must move to the Clear all filters button of the "No work orders match these filters" message.* On staging the focus is lost: it falls to the page, so the next key does nothing.

For example,
* the Technician filter is set to one technician and that technician's last work order is reassigned with the keyboard
* the board is replaced by "No work orders match these filters", but no control has focus and the arrow keys do nothing

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin at *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Make a customer with two *Approved* work orders led by one technician (for example *ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha*), and a second technician to move them to.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab and click *Board View*. Type the customer's name in *Search*.
# Click *Technician* and tick the first technician. Press Escape.
# Click in *Search*, then press *Tab* until the first card shows a focus ring.
# Press *Tab* to reach the card's *More actions* (…) button, press *Enter*, choose *Reassign lead technician* with the arrow keys and press *Enter*. Pick the second technician and confirm.
#* The card leaves the column and the focus ring moves to the remaining card.
# Do the same for the remaining card.
#* "No work orders match these filters" shows, but no focus ring is anywhere and the arrow keys do nothing.

*Actual Result:*
* Keyboard focus is lost to the page after the last work order leaves the result.

*Expected Result:*
* Focus moves to the *Clear all filters* button of "No work orders match these filters". The PRD says: *"When the focused work order leaves the result (for example after a filter change or a reassignment), focus moves to the next row or card in the same group or column, or to that group or column header when none is left. When the move leaves nothing matching the filters, so the board or table is replaced by the “No work orders match these filters” empty state (S1-N1a), for example moving the last work order of the only technician chosen in the Technician filter, focus moves to its Clear all filters button."*
